sessions.phase_label: Initial landing-page polish and top-section revision
Pricing guidance and remaining page revisions
Correct-account deployment, page variants, and responsive fixes

requirements.title: Natural Top Block Layout
requirements.definition: The top block must have a visually natural layout without an empty-looking central patch or media intruding into its text.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers structural layout of the top block; the selected media and its playback are independently testable under the top-video Requirement.

requirements.title: Top Section Video Media
requirements.definition: The top-section image must be replaced by the client-specified video, and that video must play in the page preview.
requirements.boundary_note: Media selection and playback form one video mechanism; surrounding top-block spacing and text overlap remain separate layout behavior.

requirements.title: Black Timeline Section Background
requirements.definition: The middle timeline section containing the day-range blocks must use a black background.
requirements.boundary_note: The background color can be modified independently of block dividers and image alignment; the evidence appears in the opening job description rather than an indexed message.

requirements.title: Timeline Block Dividers
requirements.definition: The middle timeline section must visually separate its day-range blocks with dividing lines or an equivalent clear separator.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers separation between timeline blocks, not the section background color or image positioning; the evidence appears in the opening job description.

requirements.title: Timeline Image and Header Alignment
requirements.definition: The image in the first timeline block must align correctly with its corresponding header.
requirements.boundary_note: Limited to image/header alignment; timeline background and block separation are separately adjustable presentation behaviors.

requirements.title: Remove Week 5–6 Identity Section
requirements.definition: The section titled "第 5-6 週：身份認同（陰影整合）—地圖🗺️" must be absent from the landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: This specifically identified section can be removed independently of the Q&A and bonus sections.

requirements.title: Remove Specified Q&A Box
requirements.definition: The second-to-last Q&A box, immediately above the final questions-contact box, must be removed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the specifically located Q&A item and can be completed or reversed independently of other section removals.

requirements.title: Remove Entire Bonus Section
requirements.definition: The entire bonus section, including its specified enrollment-bonus header, must be absent.
requirements.boundary_note: The later header instruction clarifies completeness of the same section-removal behavior rather than defining a separate header Requirement.

requirements.title: Pricing Color Editing Guide
requirements.definition: Provide an accessible written guide identifying the exact code controls used to change pricing-card outlines and button colors.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested guide is an independent executable documentation artifact; it does not itself prescribe the pricing section's final colors.

requirements.title: Two-Panel Pricing Layout
requirements.definition: The pricing section must retain only two plans by removing the most expensive plan and must avoid excessive empty side space after the reduction.
requirements.boundary_note: Plan count, removal of the highest-priced plan, and resulting desktop layout are tightly coupled; monthly typography and mobile overflow have separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Monthly Pricing Typography
requirements.definition: Each monthly price must display the Chinese monthly marker 月 in smaller type than the numeric price.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a price-label typography rule independent of the number of pricing panels and their responsive width.

requirements.title: Centered Pricing Subheader
requirements.definition: The pricing page must display the text "挑選最適合你當下旅程的專屬路徑。" centered beneath the pricing header.
requirements.boundary_note: Text content and centering concern one subheader element; they are independent of pricing-card count, typography, and mobile fit.

requirements.title: Mobile Pricing Panels Fit Viewport
requirements.definition: Pricing panels must remain within the visible page frame on mobile instead of extending beyond the viewport.
requirements.boundary_note: Responsive viewport fit has its own failure trajectory and remains separate from the desktop two-panel arrangement.

requirements.title: Duplicate Completed Landing Page
requirements.definition: Create a duplicate of the landing page after the preceding requested revisions have been completed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers creation of the duplicate artifact; the intentional omission of pricing from that variant is independently testable.

requirements.title: Duplicate Page Without Pricing Section
requirements.definition: The duplicate landing-page variant must omit the entire pricing section while the pricing-page variant retains it.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a persistent property of the duplicate variant rather than the one-off act of creating that variant.

requirements.title: Secondary Course-Content CTA Coverage
requirements.definition: Every qualifying primary button above the original pricing area, including the first section, must have a secondary control labeled "👇跳到課程內容介紹👇" directly associated with it.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers presence, coverage, and label of the controls; spacing/styling and link behavior have distinct failures and actions.

requirements.title: Secondary Course-Content CTA Layout
requirements.definition: Each secondary course-content control must appear immediately beneath its primary button, with a small gap and without an additional button wrapper.
requirements.boundary_note: Placement, spacing, and wrapper treatment form one visual arrangement; whether the control performs section navigation is a separate interaction behavior.

requirements.title: Secondary CTA Course-Content Navigation
requirements.definition: The secondary course-content control must provide a link to the course-content section farther down the page, with the exact clickable element requiring clarification.
requirements.boundary_note: Navigation can fail independently of control presence and layout; message 111 leaves unresolved whether the whole control or only part of its text should be linked.

requirements.title: Instructor Section Alignment
requirements.definition: The "about your instructor" section must remain correctly aligned after the newly added photo.
requirements.boundary_note: This alignment issue concerns an independently testable section and does not share state with the top or timeline image alignment.

requirements.title: Upper-Right YouTube Link
requirements.definition: A visible YouTube icon and link using the supplied destination must appear in the upper-right area of the landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the normal upper-right YouTube control; direct mobile visibility has a distinct responsive failure and fix trajectory.

requirements.title: Directly Visible Mobile YouTube Link
requirements.definition: On mobile, the YouTube control must be directly visible in the upper-right area rather than hidden inside a dropdown.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile discoverability and dropdown behavior can fail independently of the desktop YouTube link.

requirements.title: Deploy Edited Pages to New Kajabi Account
requirements.definition: The completed landing-page artifacts must be placed in the client's newly migrated Kajabi account, exporting them from the old account if necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an executable deployment obligation affecting where the maintained artifacts exist, not merely account-access administration.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client requires both page variants to be inspected but rejects the freelancer's interpretation that every listed correction applies to both; the exact variant scope of the bonus-header, pricing-subheader, and desktop YouTube corrections cannot be safely inferred.
The client wants the secondary course-content control to support section navigation, but it remains unclear whether the whole control or only the 內容介紹 text should be clickable.
